last_analysis: I can't see any scores, so I can't rank the trials. All I know is that all 9 trials trained without errors or time-limit kills. So the networks fit the time limit easily, and recipes with more samples are safe: 2 epochs gave about 231k steps (r3c3) with no time problem. Each run has only 2 seeds, so its score will be noisy. Since this is the last round, I'm combining ideas we've already tested rather than trying something untested. I'm pairing the 2-epoch, long-horizon recipe (more fresh samples, which suits a stream of always-new designs) with each of the three main network families: the per-layer token head, the global-context trunk, and the baseline with more gradient steps. That gives three different chances to beat the starting architecture. Every file below makes one clear change from an earlier trial.
